Joint transactions keep foreign inputs unsigned; root derivation remains restricted.
fixes.C4: New passkey registrations use independent random handles and preserve prior credentials still needed by another chain or composite policy.
fixes.C5: Pending or cancelled UI state never authorizes credential deletion; public pending records are persisted before installation and adoption precedes hydration.
fixes.C6: Core returns actual write/removal promises. Fresh creation conditionally commits the salt/ciphertext pair under a native origin/partition Web Lock or explicit backend-enforced atomic createItemsIfAbsent; concurrent losers and unsupported adapters cannot overwrite storage.
fixes.C7: New writes require WebCrypto/AES-GCM; authenticated historical 20000-round profile is recorded before rewrap, retaining old account-key access and retry after interruption.
fixes.C8: Trezor preserves locktime/sequence zero and verifies all unsigned fields before importing witnesses. Trezor and Ledger preserve finalized external inputs and reject unauthorized or transaction-mutating hardware replies.

fixes.C1: Onboarding secrets remain in document memory, never router history. Completion, exit and visibility/page lifecycle clear them. Lost creation acknowledgements cannot replay creation.
fixes.C2: Wallet-managed P256 setup rejects any externally supplied initial config before WebAuthn or installation; ECDSA external-owner consent remains explicit.
fixes.C3: Validate approved-account paths/public keys/spent scripts, strip every foreign signing hint before private-key use, require at least one approved input when unfinished inputs exist, and restore only public metadata afterward. Joint transactions keep foreign inputs unsigned; root derivation remains restricted.
fixes.C4: New passkey registrations use independent random handles and preserve prior credentials still needed by another chain or composite policy.
fixes.C5: Pending or cancelled UI state never authorizes credential deletion; public pending records are persisted before installation and adoption precedes hydration.
fixes.C6: Core returns actual storage write/removal promises; migrations await persistence and optional diagnostic failures are handled. Fresh-vault salt and ciphertext are encrypted first and committed in one native batch; sequential-only adapters fail before writing.
fixes.C7: New writes require WebCrypto/AES-GCM; authenticated historical 20000-round profile is recorded before rewrap, retaining old account-key access and retry after interruption.
fixes.C8: Trezor preserves locktime and sequence zero and verifies all unsigned transaction fields before accepting returned witnesses.

findings.title: Preserve finalized inputs through hardware conversion
findings.verifiedBehavior: Trezor sends finalized entries as EXTERNAL with supplied final bytes, verifies both returned and live final bytes, and skips importing signatures there. Ledger preserves final scripts/witness and prevout in PSBTv2 without derivations, rejects returned signatures for those entries, and skips re-finalizing them.
remainingLimitations: Fixtures exercise converters/serialization and mocked device responses; no physical Ledger or Trezor validation.
Preserving finalized external bytes does not independently authenticate their signatures.

findings.title: Refuse initialization when either vault record already exists
findings.verifiedBehavior: A fresh session rejects either non-nullish vault record before creating a salt/KDF/write. Fresh initialization always supplies freshVaultKeys to the conditional pair-creation path. Only an already-live matching session can repeat initialization after a read-only persisted mnemonic check.
remainingLimitations: Existing persisted wallets restore through unlock; fresh initialization deliberately refuses complete or incomplete existing storage.

findings.title: Make the fresh-vault check atomic across execution contexts
findings.verifiedBehavior: Fresh pair creation uses createManyIfAbsent. Exact native chrome/browser storage.local clients hold the same origin/partition Web Lock across absence check and one awaited pair write; custom backends must supply createItemsIfAbsent. Captured client/prefix cannot change while queued. Independent module tests admit one winner and preserve its pair.
remainingLimitations: No claim of CAS across browser partitions/devices.
Custom backends must implement the documented atomic primitive; arbitrary get/set adapters fail closed.

findings.title: Skip prevtx fetching for finalized witness inputs
findings.verifiedBehavior: Existing nonWitnessUtxo or finalized+witnessUtxo skips enrichment. Finalized external P2WPKH and nested P2SH-P2WPKH succeed through the public Ledger path with a rejecting backend and preserve final fields. Unfinished witness-only input and finalized legacy input without prevout still fetch/fail when unavailable.
remainingLimitations: This is a conditional enrichment skip, not a broader change to Ledger previous-transaction policy.
External final signatures are preserved rather than independently revalidated.

findings.title: Reject all script-path metadata before inferring the internal key
findings.verifiedBehavior: The missing-internal-key arm requires no tapLeafScript, no tapScriptSig, and no nonempty leafHashes in any Taproot derivation. It still authenticates the derived key plus supplied Merkle root against the actual spent output. Real single-leaf root and valid script-signature fixtures reject before hd.sign.
remainingLimitations: Only the absent-internal-key inference branch changed; existing explicit-key behavior is retained.
No new script-path, MuSig or hardware Taproot support is claimed.

ordinaryAndJoint: Approved-account P2WPKH and standard P2WSH/P2SH-P2WSH/P2SH multisig sign through real public APIs.
Foreign and same-wallet-other-account inputs remain unsigned; only their own signing hints are hidden during signing and public metadata is restored.
Conflicting paths/keys/prevouts reject before signing; imported key normalization remains bounded.
taprootKeyPath: Path plus BIP371 empty leaf hashes succeeds without tapInternalKey, with and without a known Merkle root.
Explicit-internal-key controls still succeed with and without known root.
All successful key-path fixtures verify Schnorr signatures over their real spent outputs/amounts.
Missing-key requests carrying script-path markers reject before private signing.
offlineLedger: Finalized witness-only external inputs are carried without backend fetch.
Unfinished missing previous transactions and finalized entries without prevout data retain prior fetch/failure behavior.
